description: Search Tresca's MCP servers, agent skills and plugins for engineering software by text, or browse by tool, discipline or AI client; filter by type, official, operating system and whether it can change models. Returns the facts that decide a choice and each listing's Tresca page. Order: official first, then most recently updated (with a query, best matches first); never a ranking. Words like 'best' or 'MCP' are ignored; if no listing matches every word, listings matching some of them are returned with a note. Needs a query, tool, discipline, client, or official: true.

access.description: Whether it can change models or files

client.description: AI client named in the project's docs, e.g. "Claude Code", "Cursor"

discipline.description: Discipline slug or slugs from list_disciplines, e.g. "geotechnical-engineering", or ["fea-simulation", "cfd"]; "simulation" covers both

official.description: true: only listings the software's vendor publishes

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "revit", "plaxis python", "kicad drc"

tool.description: Tool slug or name, e.g. "autocad", "Ansys Mechanical", "civil3d"

type.description: Only MCP servers, agent skills or plugins

name: search_listings
title: Search MCP servers and agent skills for engineering software
